info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v3-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of withdrawal requests from investment portfolios. By allowing designated users to delete existing withdrawal requests, it ensures that portfolio management remains flexible and responsive to changing investor needs. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, asset management firms, and portfolio managers who require the ability to adjust withdrawal strategies. Whether responding to market conditions or investor preferences, this API streamlines the process of maintaining an optimal investment portfolio.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw a specified amount of funds from their portfolio. Ensure that adequate balance is available before processing the withdrawal request.

requestBody.description: Request body for withdrawing from a portfolio. This operation requires a specified payload to successfully process the withdrawal request.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a portfolio withdraw operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.title: Withdraw Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the withdrawal operation.

resultId.description: Identifier of the result pertaining to the withdrawal operation.

state.description: Current state of the withdrawal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the withdrawal request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional informational message regarding the result of the withdrawal operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the delete operation on a portfolio withdrawal. It contains the status and details of the operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the withdrawal operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the withdrawal operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was performed automatically or manually.

AuditDetails.description: Contains information about the audit for the withdrawal operation.

schema.description: The total time in milliseconds that the request took to process.
